verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs describe subscribable webhooks: Warp sends an HTTPS POST to your endpoint for each subscribed event. Deliveries follow the Standard Webhooks spec, so they can be verified with a standard library or the TypeScript/Go SDKs, and failed deliveries are retried up to 12 times with exponential backoff. missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog and endpoint registration mechanism (API vs dashboard), independent or hands-on corroboration.
